segments.ja500:1.1: Paññāyupetaṃ siriyā vihīnaṃ, yasassinaṃ vāpi apetapaññaṃ;
segments.ja500:1.3: Pucchāmi taṃ senaka etamatthaṃ, kamettha seyyo kusalā vadanti.
segments.ja500:2.1: Dhīrā ca bālā ca have janinda, sippūpapannā ca asippino ca;
segments.ja500:2.3: Sujātimantopi ajātimassa, yasassino pesakarā [pessakarā (sī. pī.)] bhavanti;
segments.ja500:2.5: Etampi disvāna ahaṃ vadāmi, pañño nihīno sirīmāva [sirimāva (sī. syā. pī.)] seyyo.
segments.ja500:3.3: Bālaṃ yasassiṃ paṇḍitaṃ appabhogaṃ, kamettha seyyo kusalā vadanti.
segments.ja500:4.1: Pāpāni kammāni karoti bālo [karonti bālā (syā. ka.)], idhameva [idameva (syā. ka. aṭṭha.), imameva (ka.)] seyyo iti maññamāno [maññamānā (syā. ka.)];
segments.ja500:4.5: Etampi disvāna ahaṃ vadāmi, paññova seyyo na yasassi bālo.
segments.ja500:5.1: Na sippametaṃ vidadhāti bhogaṃ, na bandhuvā [na bandhavā (sī. syā. ka.)] na sarīravaṇṇo yo [na sarīrāvakāso (sī. syā. pī.)];
segments.ja500:5.3: Passeḷamūgaṃ sukhamedhamānaṃ, sirī hi naṃ bhajate goravindaṃ [gorimandaṃ (sī. pī.)];
segments.ja500:5.5: Etampi disvāna ahaṃ vadāmi, pañño nihīno sirīmāva seyyo.
segments.ja500:6.1: Laddhā sukhaṃ majjati appapañño, dukkhena phuṭṭhopi pamohameti;
segments.ja500:6.3: Āgantunā dukkhasukhena phuṭṭho, pavedhati vāricarova ghamme;
segments.ja500:6.5: Etampi disvāna ahaṃ vadāmi, paññova seyyo na yasassi bālo.
segments.ja500:7.1: Dumaṃ yathā sāduphalaṃ araññe, samantato samabhisaranti [samabhicaranti (sī. pī.)] pakkhī;
segments.ja500:7.3: Evampi aḍḍhaṃ sadhanaṃ sabhogaṃ, bahujjano bhajati atthahetu;
segments.ja500:7.5: Etampi disvāna ahaṃ vadāmi, pañño nihīno sirīmāva seyyo.
segments.ja500:8.1: Na sādhu balavā bālo, sāhasā vindate dhanaṃ;
segments.ja500:8.5: Etampi disvāna ahaṃ vadāmi, paññova seyyo na yasassi bālo.
segments.ja500:9.1: Yā kāci najjo gaṅgamabhissavanti, sabbāva tā nāmagottaṃ jahanti;
segments.ja500:9.3: Gaṅgā samuddaṃ paṭipajjamānā, na khāyate iddhiṃ paññopi loke [iddhiparo hi loke (ka. sī. syā.), iddhiparo hi loko (sī. pī. aṭṭha.)];
segments.ja500:9.5: Etampi disvāna ahaṃ vadāmi, pañño nihīno sirīmāva seyyo.
segments.ja500:10.1: Yametamakkhā udadhiṃ mahantaṃ, savanti najjo sabbakālamasaṅkhyaṃ;
segments.ja500:10.3: So sāgaro niccamuḷāravego, velaṃ na acceti mahāsamuddo.
segments.ja500:11.1: Evampi bālassa pajappitāni, paññaṃ na acceti sirī kadāci;
segments.ja500:11.3: Etampi disvāna ahaṃ vadāmi, paññova seyyo na yasassi bālo.
segments.ja500:12.1: Asaññato cepi paresamatthaṃ, bhaṇāti sandhānagato [saṇṭhānagato (syā. pī.), santhānagato (sī.)] yasassī;
segments.ja500:12.3: Tasseva taṃ rūhati ñātimajjhe, sirī hi naṃ [sirihīnaṃ (sī. ka.), sirīhīnaṃ (syā. pī.)] kārayate na paññā [na pañño (sī.), na paññaṃ (syā. ka.)];
segments.ja500:12.5: Etampi disvāna ahaṃ vadāmi, pañño nihīno sirīmāva seyyo.
segments.ja500:13.1: Parassa vā attano vāpi hetu, bālo musā bhāsati appapañño;
segments.ja500:13.3: So nindito hoti sabhāya majjhe, pacchāpi [peccampi (sī. pī.), peccāpi (?)] so duggatigāmī hoti;
segments.ja500:13.5: Etampi disvāna ahaṃ vadāmi, paññova seyyo na yasassi bālo.
segments.ja500:14.1: Atthampi ce bhāsati bhūripañño, anāḷhiyo [anālayo (pī.)] appadhano daliddo;
segments.ja500:14.3: Na tassa taṃ rūhati ñātimajjhe, sirī ca paññāṇavato na hoti;
segments.ja500:14.5: Etampi disvāna ahaṃ vadāmi, pañño nihīno sirīmāva seyyo.
segments.ja500:15.1: Parassa vā attano vāpi hetu, na bhāsati alikaṃ bhūripañño;
segments.ja500:15.3: So pūjito hoti sabhāya majjhe, pacchāpi so suggatigāmī hoti;
segments.ja500:15.5: Etampi disvāna ahaṃ vadāmi, paññova seyyo na yasassi bālo.
segments.ja500:16.1: Hatthī gavassā maṇikuṇḍalā ca, thiyo ca iddhesu kulesu jātā;
segments.ja500:16.3: Sabbāva tā upabhogā bhavanti, iddhassa posassa aniddhimanto;
segments.ja500:16.5: Etampi disvāna ahaṃ vadāmi, pañño nihīno sirīmāva seyyo.
segments.ja500:17.3: Sirī jahati dummedhaṃ, jiṇṇaṃva urago tacaṃ;
segments.ja500:17.5: Etampi disvāna ahaṃ vadāmi, paññova seyyo na yasassi bālo.
segments.ja500:18.1: Pañca paṇḍitā mayaṃ bhaddante, sabbe pañjalikā upaṭṭhitā;
segments.ja500:18.3: Tvaṃ no abhibhuyya issarosi, sakkova bhūtapati devarājā;
segments.ja500:18.5: Etampi disvāna ahaṃ vadāmi, pañño nihīno sirīmāva seyyo.
segments.ja500:19.1: Dāsova paññassa yasassi bālo, atthesu jātesu tathāvidhesu;
segments.ja500:19.3: Yaṃ paṇḍito nipuṇaṃ saṃvidheti, sammohamāpajjati tattha bālo;
segments.ja500:19.5: Etampi disvāna ahaṃ vadāmi, paññova seyyo na yasassi bālo.
segments.ja500:20.1: Addhā hi paññāva sataṃ pasatthā, kantā sirī bhogaratā manussā;
segments.ja500:20.3: Ñāṇañca buddhānamatulyarūpaṃ, paññaṃ na acceti sirī kadāci.
segments.ja500:21.1: Yaṃ taṃ apucchimha akittayī no, mahosadha kevaladhammadassī;
segments.ja500:21.3: Gavaṃ sahassaṃ usabhañca nāgaṃ, ājaññayutte ca rathe dasa ime;
segments.ja500:21.5: Pañhassa veyyākaraṇena tuṭṭho, dadāmi te gāmavarāni soḷasāti.
